Harrogate Town CNG Stadium, Harrogate 10/07/2015

 

Luke Murphy is the only absentee today, having had surgery on a badly twisted knee he picked up in training. Uwe Rosler will be putting out two different teams in each half, so it's likely that we'll see most of the squad in action. We should also get a better idea of the formation and style in which Rosler will be wanting to play this season, and while Harrogate shouldn't pose too much of a threat, it looks like a great warm up game ahead of the more challenging friendlies later this month.
